data.name: Ibtihalat
data.gender_notes: Ibtihalat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Ibtihalat is derived from the Arabic root letters ‘ibtah’ which means ‘to begin’ or ‘to start’. In Islamic tradition, the name signifies the act of investigation, exploration, or delving into knowledge and wisdom. It is a spiritual name that encourages continuous learning and seeking truth. The name Ibtihalat carries the meaning “Exploration, investigation” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ibtihalat usually hope their child will grow to embody exploration, investigation and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Ibtihalat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exploration, investigation.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ibtihalat total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ابتهالات
in_arabic.meaning: اللّٰه تعالیٰ کی جانب سے ملنے والی بشارت اور فتح

The name embodies spiritual aspiration and is considered an auspicious choice for Muslim children, reflecting a deep connection with divine providence.
